errors.evidence: Description states the orange sector 'Баланс на риска между страните' is 19.0%, while it is actually 26.2%.
Description fails to mention the gray sector 'Условия за плащане', which is also present in the pie chart.
Description states the blue sector is the largest, but fails to clarify that the gray sector 'Условия за плащане' is missing a defined percentage.
The description does not specify that the pie chart is meant to display the distribution of questions analyzed in the contract project.
The description incorrectly states the gray and light blue sectors do not have assigned percentages, while they visually represent approximately 10% and 5% respectively.
